per_depth.common_affordance: The semantic equivalence between a zero conflict score and a proper coloring of the interaction graph with three colors
The modular resonance condition over the three values 1, 2, and 3 directly collapses to forbidding equal values on every proximity edge, i.e. ordinary graph 3-coloring.
The cross product of (1, f_u, f_u^2) and (1, f_v, f_v^2) is zero exactly when f_u = f_v, turning the entire problem into proper 3-coloring.

per_depth.shortcut_name: direct 3-coloring reduction with naive lexicographic DFS
per_depth.common_affordance: The matrix condition is exactly ordinary 3-colorability: every proximity edge forbids equal assigned values, allowing the models to replace the stated resonance problem with naive 3-coloring DFS.
The cubic has roots 0, f_u, and f_v, so the stability condition is exactly that adjacent relays receive different values from {1,2,3}, i.e. graph 3-coloring.
The stability inequality collapses to the constraint f_u != f_v, making the task exactly proper 3-coloring with lexicographic DFS.
